why: The first camera, `hall-exterior`, stops answering `concept/noon-hall` and names what it frames in `note` instead, as a test level's camera does. The gallery is not a test level: every showcase camera of a campaign answers an approved image, so the build refuses the record under `DW0721`, naming the camera, before anything is placed. On a test level, which carries no design record, the same row builds and `delvec cameras` draws it (`crates/delvec/tests/test_level.rs`).
